svg.aria-label: The journey. 2021: Started building. Courses, side projects, and a lot of broken builds. 2023: First paid work. Full-stack web apps for real users. 2025: Joined Reelax. Trainee in July, Software Engineer by December. 2026: Launched Twik. Backend owner, 125,110 signups on the biggest day. Next: Your team? Looking for a mobile or frontend engineering role.
